messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "discuss benefits and risks of treatment with healthcare provider"
set: ["discuss benefits and risks of treatment with healthcare provider", "discuss risks and benefits with doctor", "discuss treatment with doctor", "talk with doctor about benefits of breastfeeding and treatment need", "consult healthcare provider for right treatment and support", "healthcare provider can discuss registering with National Pregnancy Registry for Antidepressants", "healthcare provider", "longer treatment should be guided by relative benefits and risks for individual patient", "healthcare provider or pharmacist should go through risks and safe use", "talk with your healthcare provider about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for this medicine", "only used in pregnancy if benefits outweigh risks", "risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse", "keep all follow-up visits with healthcare provider", "treatment of adults with", "talk to healthcare provider if become pregnant during treatment", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
